packages.name: MacaronCore
packages.description: Shared library used only by doku_macaron's Mycopunk mods: adds a MODS tab to the Settings window (ON/OFF rows, colour pickers, English/Japanese labels) and logs hotkey conflicts. Replaces doku_macaron-ModKit.

packages.name: UpgradeLagFix
packages.description: Removes the freezes when many upgrades are stacked on one gear (Ouroboros/Blitz). Client-side, no gameplay changes: same stats, same apply order, only faster lookups.

packages.name: QuickTimers
packages.description: Shorter fixed waits: skips the startup animations, and (opt-in) shortens the mission drop, start, end and extraction delays. The host's settings apply to the lobby.

packages.name: HealthNumbers
packages.description: Shows your health as numbers next to the health bar, and each teammate's health under their name in the teammate HUD.

packages.name: DPSChecker
packages.description: Shows your and your teammates' DPS, best DPS and kills on the HUD. Players who have it share exact values; others are estimated.

packages.name: MissionLog
packages.description: Writes one line per mission (result, time, mission, threat, modifiers, DPS...) to a TSV file, so you can look back at your runs. Read-only: never touches the save.

packages.name: PingDistance
packages.description: Shows the distance in metres under pings and objective markers.

packages.name: AbilityCooldown
packages.description: Shows the seconds until the next charge on ability icons, with charge counts for stacking abilities.

packages.name: ThrowPreview
packages.description: Shows the arc and landing point of grenades (hold to aim, release to throw) and of held objects such as a teammate's parts, coloured when the throw would revive them.

packages.name: XPNumbers
packages.description: Adds the XP into the current level and the XP the next level needs to the level bars (class screen, build screen and mission results).

packages.name: WeaponCycle
packages.description: Puts a picked-up heavy weapon into the scroll wheel and weapon 1 key cycle, and lets the wheel skip weapons that are out of ammo.

packages.name: SystemMonitor
packages.description: Shows FPS and your ping to the host in a corner of the screen.

packages.name: HealthRegenTimer
packages.description: Shows the seconds until health regeneration starts, above the health bar.

packages.name: SpeedMonitor
packages.description: Shows your current movement speed under the health bar, measured from how far you actually move, so air and glide speed count too.
